name: Lovable MCP Server
desc: MCP server that lets outside AI clients build and manage Lovable projects.
desc_zh: 让外部 AI 客户端搭建和管理 Lovable 项目的 MCP 服务。
solves: Your agent already knows how to call tools but has no way to reach the app you are building; one server URL gives it the whole project.
solves_zh: 你的智能体会调工具，却碰不到你正在做的应用；一个服务地址就把整个项目交给它。
best_for: You are in Claude Code or Cursor and want the app changed without switching windows.
best_for_zh: 你正在 Claude Code 或 Cursor 里，想不改窗口就把应用改掉。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — docs.lovable.dev/changelog）。 Research preview dated May 18, 2026; the same changelog shows it opened to all plans including Free on Jun 3, 2026. Recorded as a standalone API surface, distinct from the Lovable product itself. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：厂商没有公布中文名，name_zh 按 name。 首次公开日期来源：https://docs.lovable.dev/changelog
